text:
Noah: quick one 1 1 Orchid Systems needs a tiny evidence handoff for their POC today: SOC2 controls snippet (storage + network), a signed pen-test attestation, a presigned upload link (they prefer 48h), and a clear Dedicated burst overage note for quoting. Can we split?
Priya: I can extract storage/network controls and include control IDs + a one-line plain-English blurb. Will redact hostnames.
Gwen: Legal/pen-test: need vendor name + scan scope + POC contact to sign. Also confirm retention for uploads.
Noah: vendor = RedTeamX. contact = secops@orchidsys.com. scope = external app + a single staging CIDR. Retention requested = 7 days.
Leo: I can create a presign 24h by default; will reissue 48h after legal ok. Command I'll run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpacks/orchid/poc.zip --expires-in 86400`
Priya: include EU residency note, they said uploads must stay in eu-west. I'll mark any prod-only controls and include an evidence index.
Ivy: For Dedicated bursts: short bursts are allowed but billable. We usually show ~20% uplift on short bursts; if you give baseline (GPUs & hours) I can calc line-item.
Noah: baseline = 3 x A10g for 48h, expecting 5h/day burst for 2 days.
Ivy: will post a quick estimate.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: do not include raw logs or internal topology diagrams in external excerpts; add redaction + retention notes.
Gwen: drafting attestation now. Sample line: "RedTeamX conducted an external webapp and staging network scan during the POC window; Redwood did not access customer keys or secrets." Will sign once Priya confirms redaction.
Priya: excerpt ready, redacted, control IDs included, EU residency statement added. Uploading to thread.
Gwen: Signed pen-test attestation uploaded.
Leo: Presign created (24h): https://s3-presign.example/orchid-1729 (expires in 24h). I will reissue 48h after legal confirms retention.
Noah: sent package to secops@orchidsys.com with SOC2 snippet, attestation, 24h presign and burst note. Customer replied: "need 48h presign and confirmation of 7-day deletion".
Gwen: 48h ok. Priya, reissue presign 48h?
Priya: reissuing now.
Leo: New presign (48h): https://s3-presign.example/orchid-1729-48h (expires in 48h). Auto-delete scheduled in 7 days.
Ivy: Burst estimate: uplift 20% -> approx $720 extra for requested burst window. Posting line-item.
Noah: sent updated package and quote to secops@orchidsys.com. They acknowledged uploading starts now. Closing thread when upload completes. :thumbsup:
